name: Vowelconsonantinterleavecipher

description_json.name: VowelConsonantInterleaveCipher
description_json.idea: To obscure text while keeping it highly readable for a language model, we separate vowels and consonants into two distinct groups and shift them independently. Vowels (A, E, I, O, U) are shifted forward by 2 positions in the vowel sequence (A->I, E->O, I->U, O->A, U->E). Consonants are shifted forward by 2 positions in the alphabet, skipping any vowels (e.g., B->D, C->F, D->G, F->H, etc.). Case is preserved. Numbers, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (case-insensitive), shift it forward by 2 positions in the vowel loop: [A, E, I, O, U]. (A->I, E->O, I->U, O->A, U->E). Maintain original casing.
2. If it is a consonant (case-insensitive), shift it forward by 2 positions in the consonant-only alphabet (which excludes A, E, I, O, U). For example, B becomes D, D becomes G (skipping E), H becomes K (skipping I), etc. Maintain original casing.
3. If it is a digit, space, or punctuation mark, leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (case-insensitive), shift it backward by 2 positions in the vowel loop: [A, E, I, O, U]. (I->A, O->E, U->I, A->O, E->U). Maintain original casing.
2. If it is a consonant (case-insensitive), shift it backward by 2 positions in the consonant-only alphabet (excluding A, E, I, O, U). Maintain original casing.
3. If it is a digit, space, or punctuation mark, leave it unchanged.
